history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-22, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#627; borg-reborn-rs #882, PR #893). Four arms on one
build in the breeders-x4 world (borg_world breeders-x4 in every arm), classes-18 gate first (18 starts per arm, 72 cells),
100,000 turns, evidence retained; then the #482 starts 1-360 in the world and a normal-world slice (small + medium) for harm,
on the owner's go. Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell records world breeders-x4 with the same
borg_world_data_sha256 in every arm; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or
borg_stopped; stalls apart; death bundles reproduced with the same world. Primary: deaths with a breeder as killer or last
attacker (including poison with a breeder as last attacker). Secondary: all deaths, mean CL and max depth, unfinished games,
the "Retreating to"/"Backing up" notes on levels with breeders, and the rule's notes ("Cutting out through the breeders",
"Holding against the breeders", "Leaving the breeders by the stairs"). Paired rescued and newly killed against ctl (exact
McNemar), per class (Priest, Mage, Necromancer, Druid apart). A breeder world is a stress test; a confirmation needs a
block not yet read. Directional (RULES 14).
experiment.question: In the breeders-x4 world on borg-reborn-rs 6062b84a (PR #893), does the slow-breeder rule "hold, or cut the known way out; never retreat into the colony" (caution_breeder_policy -1 with caution_breeder_hold 1), or policy 4 or 6, save the games lost to breeders against the shipped policy 3?
